dct_title_s: Caribbean Sea, South America, Colombia, approaches to Bahía de Cartagena (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: Prepared and published by the Defense Mapping Agency Hydrographic/Topographic Center. Depths shown by isolines and soundings. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. "From Colombian and U.S. charts to 1992." "Copyright 1995 by the United States Government. No copyright claimed under Title 17 U.S.C." "Soundings in meters." Includes source diagram and tidal information. Map no.24510.
